error[ZBX-E0311]: --ulimit is above your own hard limit
  while  checking --ulimit nofile
  cause  --ulimit nofile asks for a hard limit of 1048576, above your own,
         524288; a rootless run can't raise it
  asked  1048576
  hard   524288
  unit   LimitNOFILE=1048576
  fix    raise it for logins (then log in again):    echo "$(id -un) hard nofile 1048576" | sudo tee -a /etc/security/limits.conf
         or for the user manager, under [Service]:   sudo systemctl edit user@1000.service
  more   zbx explain E0311
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0311.html
